propositions: make lint and make typecheck execute twice in CI: once as direct named steps and again when pre-commit run --all-files re-invokes the local lint and typecheck hooks
OSS-practice comparison shows idiomatic CI setups run each linter exactly once through a single mechanism, not redundantly through multiple paths
The CI pre-commit step should skip lint and typecheck hooks by adding them to the SKIP environment variable in both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml workflows
The lint and typecheck hooks must remain present and active in .pre-commit-config.yaml so local git commits still enforce them
A regression test assertion in test_ci_workflow_parity.py should verify that CI pre-commit steps skip lint and typecheck to prevent the double-run from silently returning
